changeSet.author: eduar.troyano
changeSet.comment: Crea la tabla llm_call_logs: registro solo de inserción de cada llamada al LLM (la escribe ai/; sin auditoría). Incluye secuencia propia (sin tabla de auditoría: tabla de volumen alto o de solo inserción).

createTable.remarks: Append-only log of every LLM call attempt. Written by the ai service. No audit table

column.name: id
column.remarks: Primary key

column.name: ai_job_id
column.remarks: AI job that made the call

column.name: enrollment_id
column.remarks: Enrollment related to the call, when applicable

column.name: provider
column.remarks: LLM provider

column.name: task
column.remarks: Task performed (syllabus extraction, grading, ...)

column.name: model
column.remarks: Model used

column.name: prompt_id
column.remarks: Prompt id

column.name: prompt_version
column.remarks: Prompt version

column.name: input_sha256
column.remarks: SHA-256 of the input; the input itself is not stored

column.name: json_valid
column.remarks: Whether the output was valid JSON for the contract

column.name: call_attempt
column.remarks: Attempt number of the call inside the job

column.name: from_cache
column.remarks: Whether the output came from the cache

column.name: input_tokens
column.remarks: Input tokens

column.name: output_tokens
column.remarks: Output tokens

column.name: cost_usd
column.remarks: Estimated cost in USD; null when the model has no price

column.name: latency_ms
column.remarks: Latency in milliseconds

column.name: status
column.remarks: Call result: success, error, invalid_output or budget_exceeded

column.name: error_message
column.remarks: Error message when the call failed

column.name: active
column.remarks: Logical state: false means deactivated (rows are never deleted)

column.name: created_at
column.remarks: Creation timestamp

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE llm_call_logs ADD CONSTRAINT llm_call_logs_status_ck CHECK (status IN ('success', 'error', 'invalid_output', 'budget_exceeded'))
